source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Timothy
I have a quick job. Like to see if you’re free.

•	I have a paperback cover that needs 2 small fixes (delete a few words of my blurb + matching the title font across front/spine/back). No redesign, files are final otherwise. 
•	Output needed: .psd (layered), .pdf, .jpg 
•	Needed within 24 hours 
•	Are you available?

My budget is $30.

Best,
Caryn

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I can't believe I still haven't heard from D2D. Let's hold off on this until tomorrow. I'll order something (which may or may not be the right specs for the cover). I will give them one more day. Thanks for your patience. Best, Caryn

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi Tim — quick update: I don't have an Ingram account to verify this myself, so I've asked D2D directly what paper-thickness factor they're using, since it looks like Ingram's cream stock may just genuinely run thinner than Amazon's, which could explain the spine difference. (Unfortunately - D2D is slow in replying). I will check with some author FB groups to see if anyone knows. Very frustrating. Can we keep this job open another day or two? thanks! The upside is I know now to have 2 covers made. Didn't have this problem with book 1 :). In the meantime can you confirm the page count, font etc you used in the updated cover? Thx

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
HI Timothy,
Go ahead and do the D2D cover at the D2D template spine width 0.68 inches. I'll modify the job to add $20. No word from D2D. However I can't believe there's a bug in their template - otherwise many authors would complain. Thanks,
Best,
Caryn

routing_warnings.description: The instruction to delay the unresolved spine work primarily affects the D2D cover specification rather than independently changing the overall delivery deadline.
The 0.68-inch hold and unresolved spine-width evidence primarily changes the D2D cover specification; the later message 55 directly establishes the associated delivery extension.
